highlights: 1.6.14: faster videos while muse.ai is overloaded. While muse.ai is overloaded, a failed video takes 6-7 minutes before it reports a 503, and retrying with another account is another full round. Now, whenever an overload reply has appeared in the last 20 minutes, new video tasks generate on 2 idle accounts at once; the first finished video wins and the other attempt is cancelled immediately (not recorded as an account fault, not retried).

When muse.ai is healthy, behavior is unchanged (single account); image tasks and tasks pinned to an account do not run in parallel. Cost: during an overload, each video uses 2 accounts' quota. Use MUSE2API_VIDEO_HEDGE=0 to turn it off and MUSE2API_VIDEO_HEDGE_WINDOW to adjust the duration. After a service restart, the parallel state is restored from recent task records. No browser extension upgrade is needed.
highlights_en: 1.6.14: faster videos while muse.ai is overloaded. A failed video turn takes 6-7 minutes before muse.ai reports the 503, and the retry is another full round. For 20 minutes after any overload reply, new video tasks now run on two idle accounts at once; the first finished video wins and the other attempt is cancelled at once (not booked as an account fault, not retried).

Nothing changes while muse.ai is healthy (one account); image tasks and tasks pinned to an account never run in parallel. Cost: during an overload each video uses two accounts' allowance. MUSE2API_VIDEO_HEDGE=0 turns it off, MUSE2API_VIDEO_HEDGE_WINDOW sets the duration. After a restart the state is restored from recent task records. No extension upgrade is needed.
